title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Wikimedia…
description: A Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Wikimedia Foundation MediaWiki ContentTranslation Extension affecting versions 1.43, 1.45, 1.46, and 1.47. The flaw involves improper neutralization of input during web page generation in specific program files. This vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.1. No patch or remediation information is currently provided.
